violations.explanation: The safe pub fn passes a caller-supplied Layout straight to GlobalAlloc::alloc. It does not check that the size is non-zero, so a zero-sized layout is undefined behavior.

violations.requirement: ptr must denote a block currently allocated via this allocator, and layout must be the same layout used to allocate it
violations.explanation: The safe pub fn passes an arbitrary caller-supplied pointer and layout to GlobalAlloc::dealloc. Nothing checks that the pointer came from this allocator or that the layout matches.
Layout::new::<T>() has size 0 when T is zero-sized, and Box::new does not guard against that. The call therefore violates the non-zero-size requirement of GlobalAlloc::alloc.
